page.content:
1976 blind tasting where California beat top Bordeaux and Burgundy.

How Judgment of Paris connects

  • Location: Napa Valley — The 1976 Judgment of Paris made Napa a peer in the fine-wine story.
  • Location: Bordeaux — Paris 1976 put California cabernet above classed-growth Bordeaux in a blind vote.

What is Judgment of Paris?

Steven Spurrier's Paris tasting put Napa Chardonnay and Cabernet above French icons in a blind vote, a founding myth of New World confidence.

Key threads lead to Napa Valley and Bordeaux.
